title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Demurrage Days Billed Beyond Free Time
content:
Which days a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record charges as demurrage on its final demurrage line, and where that line begins and ends, depends on whether the product keeps separate clocks or a merged one.

## Separate clocks

- **Import:** the demurrage clock begins on the discharge date and ends on the full gate-out date, set against the product's import demurrage free days.
- **Export:** the demurrage clock begins on the full gate-in date and ends on the loading date, set against the product's export demurrage free days.

Days used means the count of calendar days separating the start date from the end date. Whatever part of the days used runs past the free days is billed as demurrage; where nothing runs past them, nothing is billed.

## Merged clock

An import record's single clock covers the span from discharge to the empty's return, and an export record's single clock the span from empty pickup to loading, set against the merged free days of that direction. Counting from the start date, day n of the merged clock is n calendar days after it.

- **Import:** every day up to the full gate-out date, that date included, is a demurrage day.
- **Export:** every day after the full gate-in date is a demurrage day.

On a merged clock, the line bills a day only if it lies past the merged free days and also counts as demurrage. By position, on import these are positions above the free days and not above the position of the full gate-out date; on export, positions above both the free days and the position of the full gate-in date.

## First and last billed day

The line opens on the first chargeable demurrage day and closes on the last one. When that last day is a terminal movement — as with the full gate-out of an import container — the line closes on the movement's own date, and not on the day the record's charges stopped.

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates and free days)

| Case | Days used | Free days | Demurrage days billed | Line runs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| separate, export: gate-in 3 July, loaded 15 July | 12 | 6 | 6, positions 7 to 12 | 10 July to 15 July |
| merged, import: discharge 1 June, gate-out 18 June, empty back 25 June | 24 | 10 | 7, positions 11 to 17 | 12 June to 18 June |
| merged, export: pickup 1 June, gate-in 20 June, loaded 28 June | 27 | 10 | 8, positions 20 to 27 | 21 June to 28 June |

In the merged import case the full gate-out date is position 17, so the line stops there even though the clock runs on to 25 June.
